_about: Nova's rig settings, read by tools/build_rig.py. His exports have no layer names, so parts are listed by their position in the flat Figma export (0-based). Re-check the positions if an export changes; the shape counts stop the build if it does.
label: Nova
_faceOffset: The head in the full-body art is the original head moved by this much, at the same scale, so the hat, eyelids and mouth shapes keep the original coordinates inside a translate.
_headScale: Manaf (2026-10-14): the head, with the hat, drawn at 90% of the art's size, shrinking toward the bottom centre of the face (where the head fur ends above the collar), so the join with the neck stays put. The face rig scales with it.

eyes._whites: Eye whites in the full-body art; the pupils stay inside them.
eyes._lids: Eye centres in the original coordinates, and the lid colour of each (the fur around that eye).
eyes._pupilRest: How far each pupil sits from its eye's centre at rest (x). The art has them turned slightly inward, so looking sideways moves each pupil a different amount to the same spot.

_outfits: Each outfit lists, by position in its own export, the shapes that make its legs, arms (fur, sleeve, then shapes drawn over the sleeve) and body, plus its hat ('cap' is the original cap). hat_back sits behind the head.

construction._note: Re-exported 2026-10-14 with a neck scarf (36-38, in front of the jacket), drawn with the head and hard hat already at 90%.
construction.label: Construction

diver._note: Outfit 4 (Manaf, 2026-10-14), drawn with the head already at 90%. Air hoses behind the arms (body_back). Each arm: the dark glove and forearm, the suit sleeve over it, the wrist gauge and the sleeve stripes; the sleeve's top hides under the collar, so it gets no round cap (sleeveCap false). The shoulder pivot is the point the right arm turns about between this drawing and armUp (the same Nova with his right arm raised); the left is its mirror. Body: suit trousers, the glass dome, collar, neck, suit, belt and chest gauge, then the collar's front. The dome is see-through, so its outline is a white ring around the outside only (outlineRing), and the inner glass gets none. No hat. The glare on the glass is a front layer (body_front): drawn over the face, it stays still with the helmet while the head moves inside, and has no outline (it would show through the glass). Nor does the head (headOutline false): it is inside the glass, and its outline would show through as a pale halo.
diver.label: Diver
